snippet.title: Wild Blue Skies Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
Attention all pilots: the skies have shifted! We’re gearing up for the adventure of a lifetime with a new name: Wild Blue Skies. 

Step into the cockpit of this old-school on-rails shooter as Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers take to the clouds to save the world. Coming to #Xbox
